description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.039 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. DeFi yield strategy planner. Given a portfolio size and risk tolerance, returns an optimized allocation across top DeFi yield opportunities. Risk tiers: low (stablecoins only, APY < 30%, TVL ≥ $50M), medium (TVL ≥ $10M, APY < 80%), high (TVL ≥ $1M, all assets). Output includes per-position allocation, APY, weekly yield estimate, chain, and 7-day APY trend. Covers 16K+ pools across 400+ DeFi protocols via DeFiLlama.
